dedupe_keys.name: urban traffic speed dataset of guangzhou china

description: Urban Traffic Speed Dataset of Guangzhou, China is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Xinyu Chen, Yixian Chen (Sun Yat-Sen University). This is an urban traffic speed dataset which consists of 214 anonymous road segments (mainly consist of urban expressways and arterials) within two months (i.e., 61 days from August 1, 2016 to September 30, 2016) at 10-minute interval, and the speed observations were collected in Guangzhou, China. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
